specification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.finding: Defines the SAT-v1 length-prefixed block carrier and the version-2 inline carrier. The general body sequence also includes common wireframe fields, which must remain within independently established version bounds.

sources.wholeReadDisposition: Strict conversion refused with four object parse failures; not a whole-file qualification.
Strict conversion refused with six object parse failures and failed IMAGEDEF source correlation; not a whole-file qualification.

method.observation: Temporary diagnostic logging emitted parsed modeler version and body bounds for each object that reached DRW_ModelerGeometry parsing. The diagnostic was removed, and the library/test target was rebuilt from the uninstrumented source afterward.

decision: These two physical sources do not justify expanding AC1015 SAT-v1 extraction to AC1018. Preserve the exact AC1018 SAT-v1 opaque control and require an eligible source or authoritative versioned layout before changing the parser.
limitations: Two local AC1018 files do not establish that no producer uses SAT-v1 in AC1018.
The diagnostic reused libdxfrw parsing and is not independent format evidence.
The result does not qualify AC1018 version-2 SAB semantics, wireframe fields, geometry, output, or native interoperability.
nextAction: Leave this profile boundary unchanged and continue with a separately evidenced local implementation item; revisit only when a qualifying AC1018 SAT-v1 source or normative version-specific rule appears.
